reviews.title: very good
reviews.text: Airline was great...Paris airport was awful...CDU needs a major renovation. I hope to never have to go through there again
reviews.author: Joan D

reviews.title: smooth and convenient flight to Lyon
reviews.text: excellent flight. Good service, easy to access. I enjoyed the flight, no hassle. I recommend this company.
reviews.author: Nunzio M

reviews.title: First flight from Orly to Lyon was good but the returning one was a horror
reviews.text: i bought the tickets online to go from paris orly to lyon and return. The flight that went from orly to Lyon was perfect but the returning one was a horror, terrible experience. after that flight im not going to take planes again.
reviews.author: Altravel

reviews.title: Good surprise
reviews.text: I had a really good experience with my short flight inside France. Punctual, easy boarding procedure, relatively comfortable cabin and polite service. Also the app works as it should. I certainly will fly with Hop! again.
reviews.author: mac

reviews.title: small Embraer plane, lagre legroom
reviews.text: take off with 90 minutes delay, a cold sandwich and one drink from the catering trolley ... you don't get more today. But the small Embraer jets offer a lot of legroom - the flight is way more comfortable that in Boeing or Airbus
reviews.author: Stefan S

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Great, very pleasant flight with very attentive crew. Would recommend this airline without hesitation. Hop is a subsidy of Air France.
reviews.author: Andrew E

reviews.title: Hop! Service
reviews.text: I travelled on Hop from Paris CDG to Birmingham England and thoroughly enjoyed the experience.We were slightly late from Paris due to an air traffic slot but nevertheless the crew and aircraft were great.A selection of drinks and a snack on board the aircraft was most welcome and not a single penny was asked for it.Very smart crew and very friendly service, if the lost cost division of Air France can do this why can’t British Airways??? Thank you Hop, I will fly with you again.
reviews.author: Keith A

reviews.title: Nice Airline
reviews.text: Very good airline...Good trained staff, on time....No problems and relaxed. Always good to consider this airline if you have the option
reviews.author: H.J.

reviews.title: Crap!
reviews.text: Awful. Boarding a shambles. Poor communication. Board at terminal 2E but bused to terminal 2G. Late departure every time I have flown Hop.
reviews.author: OnAir813835

reviews.title: A trip to such picturesque towns in Dordogne 24 France
reviews.text: Last February we decided to go for a trip to the picturesque area of Dordogne France by camping car. We discovered such nice sites , local markets, camping cars areas , and caves. We enjoyed so much walking around the historical cities , meeting cool people wandering along the riversides , . If you are in this region, Don't hesitate to visit Sarlat, Rocomadour, Montignac , Lascaux (the copy because the original cave has been closed because of the human pollution !!) Cahors.. the whole is worth visiting , sure !
reviews.author: servatm

reviews.title: Above and beyond service, low price
reviews.text: Bought an economy on Air France low cost HOP carrier. Coffee for free, seat selection for free. Good service. If I have the choice, would I take HOP again ? Yes.
reviews.author: Jprbrussels

reviews.title: Decent but timely service
reviews.text: HOP comes across as one airline which is punctual w.r.t its timings. In all my experiences, I haven't seen a delay in take-off or landing. This trip was the first leg of our Clermont-Hyderabad trip.
reviews.author: Arvind Kumar Yerram

reviews.title: serious and relative cheap
reviews.text: The flight was on time. You can arrive 30min to 1 hours before the departue it's enough. Seats are comfortable for short legs. Conditions and quality acceptable related to the price. The check-in and control is well organized.
reviews.author: Jean-Baptiste

reviews.title: Good for short flights
reviews.text: Timely service and efficient. Allowed us to check-in a bag at no extra cost instead of using the cabin space.
reviews.author: Arvind Kumar Yerram

reviews.title: Great service,,,
reviews.text: Wonderful crew..fast service.. would select this service anytime.. seats have MUCH more room than other low cost carriers...
reviews.author: Raenette D

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: We had a good experience on this flight. The flight was on time. The staff were welcoming and professional. We were given a hot drink and a sandwich on board. The seats were wide and comfy, and there was plenty of leg room. We checked in using one on the self-service screens, and it was quick and easy to do.
reviews.author: TravelLass82

reviews.title: Great service for a low cost company
reviews.text: I liked the friendly staff and the fact that the pilots were punctual. On the other hand, I had the mischance to sit on the exit row, so I couldn't keep my backpack (in which I had my laptop, my headphones, etc.) under the seat in front of me. Also, the folding table was so small, that I couldn't drink my tea and read a magazine at the same time. Overall, great value for money! Tip: If you have a connection flight and you're in a hurry, be careful as it takes long getting off the plane (especially if you are seated on the last rows) because only the front door it's used.
reviews.author: Roxanyv

reviews.title: Worst!
reviews.text: Me and my fiance took a flight from Wroclaw to CDG this weekend. I purchased extra insurance on the tickets because there was a chance we may have to leave a day early. We end up having to change the day of our flight. We go to the ticketing desk, and I ask to change our tickets to the day before we are supposed to leave. It's the same exact flight, just a day earlier. Without even looking at my ticket, they say it is impossible to exchange and that I will have to buy another set of tickets. Since I bought the arrival and departure tickets together, and used my arrival ticket already, they wouldn't do anything for us. Long story short, I had to pay €256 extra even though I paid 100PLN for insurance to avoid this situation... I figured that Air France wouldn't be the airline to do something like this.I would expect this type of treatment from a discount airline. 0/10, will never fly Air France again. Just a bit of help would have been nice...
reviews.author: Jordan C

reviews.title: Such a loss of time
reviews.text: 1st the plane was postpone 20 min. Then there was only one bus instead of 2 to get to the plane. Then they had to load the hand luggage in the cargo. After landing all the same in reverse. Took almost 2h for a 39 minutes flight. And the comfort of the Bombardier is pretty poor compared to 737 or A320
reviews.author: quintnico

reviews.title: Faultless
reviews.text: Pleasant ground and flight staff, plane on time (arrived early), baggage ready as soon as we entered the terminal. Have never had an easier or more pleasant domestic or international flight.
reviews.author: jamesfrancisdeagan

reviews.title: On Time- Clean- Snacks!
reviews.text: Plane left and arrived on time. The small jet we travelled in was clean and the seats reasonable comfortable. Passengers were looked after by two cabin crew, who were efficient and friendly. I was impressed with the fact that we were given a free small snack and a coffee on this very short flight (British Airways- you might learn from this!). The price of the flight was also very reasonable. I'd have no hesitation in flying HOP! again.
reviews.author: Gary_Childers

reviews.title: Operated by Air France. But better
reviews.text: I’d recommend this company for a short flight in Europe any day over Air France. Budget airline but better in my option. The only negative part was you find out your gate number half hour before your flight. Other than that it’s definitely worth the price and service to fly with them.
reviews.author: Scott M

reviews.title: Not worth flying business class
reviews.text: I flew business class and its not worth it. You do get a different meal from economy but thats it. Seat and legroom is the same they just leave the middle seat vacant so you can have extra space
reviews.author: davehwan

reviews.title: Late takeoff
reviews.text: This flight was to Toulouse from Prague via Lyon. The flight left Prague about 45minutes late. We were told nothing although we had a connection at Lyon to Toulouse. Our connection time was about 90 minutes. Once on board the flight was okay. We had booked these flights in May for September but were allocated the leftover centre seats for the leg from Lyon. We were most unhappy!
reviews.author: N N

reviews.title: uneventful flight, so that's good
reviews.text: Brussels Airport is about the same distance as Lille from our home, but a lot smaller and more convenient. There are 2 airlines flying from Lille to Nice. I like the approach to Nice during daytime, the Azure coast is a gem from the air and the ground
reviews.author: Hendrik_Demol

reviews.title: Not worth the saving
reviews.text: All 3 flights we took with Hop were delayed. A flight to From marseille to Caen through Lyon was delayed almost 1 hour. Because the late arrival, We missed the 2nd leg of my flight and had to wait another 4 hours (In Lyon we had to change plans). We got our suitcase only the next day... Our general impression from Hop employees was that they were all very nice but very low on knowledge and (the right) actions... I will do my best to avoid Hop in the future.
reviews.author: tapeterlee2015

reviews.title: Makes Air France look like a cowboy outfit
reviews.text: Having flown out to Paris on Air France and receiving half a cup of coffee as we were about to land and Brioche Bun, I have to say that their low cost child is a far superior outfit. New Embraer aircraft, 2 x 2 seating with excellent leg room and also inflight catering of a high standard if you like goats cheese that is? Left and landed on time, aircraft clean and crew pleasant what more do you need on a 45 minute flight, Air France need learn from this small subsidiary.
reviews.author: j0hnhill

reviews.title: Hop (part of Air France)
reviews.text: Late evening flight, using a bus gate Only 40 people on the flight on a Embracer 170, but the staff insisted that all carry ons (with wheels) were placed underneath in the hold even though there was plenty of room on the plane Flight was fine on a clear evening On Arrival we were then told that the hand luggage would be delivered with the hold luggage on the belt ? Even though there was no locks on hand luggage is was put through the system when it is normally delivered to the front of the plane on disembarkation Apart from that unnecessary mucking about a good flight
reviews.author: m0by147

reviews.title: Timely service
reviews.text: Paris to Stockholm is a short flight and as expected, it was a small flight and everything went smoothly. There was no delay of any sort and check-in, baggage drop and travel everything was on time.
reviews.author: Arvind Kumar Yerram

reviews.title: Once in the air the flight couldn't have been better.
reviews.text: This was our first experience with Hop! and, in fact, we'd never heard of it. The gate crew and in-flight crew were both excellent. The announcements were only in French but the cabin crew members all spoke English and were helpful to us. There is no jetway in Brest for this equipment, a Canadian Bombardier, so we had to take 3 flights of stairs down to the tarmac and then a flight up into the plane. When we arrived at Orly we had to do the reverse. It was an expensive flight-- costing over 700 euros for two! We learned that the price goes up as the seats are sold. When we bought our tickets 3 days prior there were only 4 seat left so the agent said "Ohhh, you're paying more because the plane is full."
reviews.author: Rumplestiltskinned

reviews.title: Succession of 2 flights : good
reviews.text: Good service in small flights. In fact we have stopped at Lyon and took the same airplane 1 hour later ! But too expansive as it is same as EasyJet !! Not better. In addition the same flight was a lot more expansive with an Air France ticket ... crazy !
reviews.author: gimougin

reviews.title: It's only a  ca1h 45 min journey and its a direct connection...
reviews.text: I have flown this stretch a few times and I find it to be more than satisfactory. Its a short flight so you don't need very much to upgrade or luxury add ons, at least not in my opinion. Sure the departure time is very early and for me not being a morning person thats a bit of a torture, but hey! On the bright side, you get a whole day in Paris ( if thats your final destination) and that more than worth it to me. The staff is at the very least professional, always warm, smiling and friendly to me. The morning service isn't very much if your used to eat a big breakfast. to me a hot or cold beverage and a pain au chocolate is to much anyways...but if you are morning hungry, baby bring something on your own...Departure from Got is always on time, departure from CDG is perhaps a little less reliable...but then again, its a much larger airport in comparison so that to be expected I think. I think its well worth the money to fly with Hop instead of changing flights somewhere else, I've done that one and that wasn't worth the money and it took me much longer to travel like that... Booking online has never been any problem and everything needed for a paperless journey have always worked really well with Apples passport app or Air France/Hop app. If your planning on taking the bus from CDG to Paris you need to take a little shuttle bus from the Hop terminal ( its free and depart regular I think every 10-15 min). Get off the shuttle bus at the first stop ( double check terminal though ) and get down one floor to where the Roissybus, Paris-Opéra departs from, its a little tricky to find an escalator to the lower level but when your there its pretty easy to find...You should have a little cash with you in case the automats for tickets doesn't work..that happens every now and then...-Oh, also, visit the WC before the busied in to Paris, depending on the time you travel it can take quite a long time due to traffic... Bon Voyage!
reviews.author: MrJonsey

reviews.title: Quick "hop" to Paris
reviews.text: We flew with Hop! to Paris from Bilbao and back, in order to connect with our flight to Tokyo. The flight was only an hour long, despite this we were offered a small breakfast (coffee/tea/water + pastry) and a sandwich on the way back. The airplane was in decent shape, clean, seats were small and cramped but again didn't bother us much considering the flight's short length. Check-in went smoothly and quick, even despite our connection towards Tokyo. Staff was friendly and helpful at all times. No entertainment other than the magazines, understandably. Overall, aside from the meal service it wasn't much different from your regular, bog-standard regional flight. Wouldn't mind flying with them again if I had to.
reviews.author: Vasconium

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: HOP! Seems to have an agreement with Air France as our flight was labeled under both airlines. Either way we took off on time and landed early. We boarded quickly and the plane was clean and comfortable.
reviews.author: Jake23

reviews.title: Correct
reviews.text: OK service with no extras. But at least you’re taken to your destination without any trouble or delay. Exactly what you expect.
reviews.author: Anna S

reviews.title: Stereotypical Desk Staff Missed Opportunity to Provide Customer Service
reviews.text: While printing boarding passes, auto fill somehow kicked in and created two tickets under one name. The young, French terminal and gate attendant told my wife that it wasn't her problem to solve. She said it twice, actually. Luckily another staff member provided the exceptional service that saved the day. She helped call to correct the problem and eventually helped get everything fixed (albeit for 15 euros). You don't have a lot of choices for airlines, so solve issues prior to getting to the airport.
reviews.author: Marc P

reviews.title: not so low cost, but low service quality
reviews.text: Both flights, on the way out and on the way back took off late, respectively by one hour and 45 minutes, the first one also experiencing passengers being held up in the plane at arrival due to an absence of staff to handle the gangway.
reviews.author: Alain T

reviews.title: refused boarding and then refused to refund
reviews.text: refused boarding and then refused to refund my flight saying i did not arrive on time, after I arrived 4 hours before the flight. will never book with HOP ever again
reviews.author: niralon

reviews.title: Good experience
reviews.text: Very good experience! Confortable plane, very clean, enough space for the legs; friendly crew. Snack, hot and cold drinks.
reviews.author: KBPatricia

reviews.title: low cost but high level
reviews.text: Excellent service and working planes, even if a bit old in the few flights i took. However they can improve their app, i was unable to use it(the air france one that is) as it required the CC number that was used for the reservation, that was made by a travel agency. Was it a workaround ? maybe, but it was not avaialble/easy to find.
reviews.author: Xavier_SRD

reviews.title: much too late as always, stinky and clattering planes ...
reviews.text: It's unbelievable that this airline is still alive ... you are lucky if your flight has only one hour delay but normally you should calculate two. The tickets are maybe a little bit cheaper (but only a LITTLE) ... but not as cheap as they should be ... never ever again. And .. by the way due to the tough time scheduling there is no time to clean the planes .... I´m done with "Hop!"
reviews.author: Veronika E

reviews.title: always too late, dirty aircrafts, unfriendly stuff
reviews.text: everything is mentioned in the headline - always too late, dirty aircrafts, unfriendly stuff. Not a single word of excuse.
reviews.author: Markus R

reviews.title: First time with Hop!
reviews.text: Flight on time, crew polite and nice, seats as good as if it were a non-low costs company. The only thing I should say that I did not appreciate is that we were supposed to make the check-in 2 hours before the flight departure. I stood there earlier and the crew went and opened the check-in only 1 hour and a half before. Since we were in the lunch hours, I could have not enjoyed this 30 minutes enough for having lunch prior the departure and had to hurry up to be on time for boarding.
reviews.author: sonito90404

reviews.title: First experience of Hop! but it was very good for a short flight to Paris
reviews.text: This was my first experience of using Hop! and on the whole, they were very good. The plane was an Embraer 190 and it was quite basic - which vinyl seats - but the legroom was file and it was clean and tidy. The staff on-board were very pleasant and efficiently sorted out a snack and drink in the 1 hour 20 minutes that it took to get from Newcastle to Paris - along with their other duties. The snacks were fine - I had a chicken wrap, but I'd go for a bottle of wine or a can of lager if I flew with them again just because you only got a small glass of water, juice or a soft drink if that was your preference. There was no on-board entertainment that I could see, but for a flight this short, none was required.
reviews.author: David L

reviews.title: Very friendly Boardteam
reviews.text: We could bring more luggage than we had declared, and could ad a Box without paying an extra charge (like Easy jet likes to do). Despite of delated departure due to a strike of the sky guider the board team did everything to get all the passengers to their destination, The pilot chose to fly lower and use a route to avoid the blocking of the sky guides in Marseille who begann the strike earlier than announced. Thanks a lot for the service and friendliness of the team and the Pilot.
reviews.author: glanzenberg

reviews.title: Flight was with delay, but still alright
reviews.text: Our flight had a delay of 30 minutes, which was fine, however, the connection in Lyon was terrible, mostly due to poor organisation and staff of airport in Lyon, we had to run to other terminal and go through security check.. again!
reviews.author: jaroslavadame

reviews.title: Nice Flight
reviews.text: Hop! Are part of Air France. Charles De Gaul is a large Airport and it was our first time departing from it.The Air France staff were very helpful advising the procedures to go through to get luggage checked in & getting us to the departure gate, If you have not flown from here, I would advise giving it 30mins extra to be on the safe side. It was very busy in April, but I can imagine it being 10 times worse in the summer. Once we got through past customs we could relax in the departure lounge. We tried the cafe and it was ok & reasonably priced. It was only a 1 hour 50 minute flight back to Aberdeen. Once we could board, we had to get on a bus to take us to the plane which takes about 6 minutes, with about a 1 minute to the aircraft. Once you get onboard the stewardess is very nice, friendly and courteous.The seat is comfortable & there is plenty leg room for a short Hop!! Before you take off, it takes aprox 14 minutes to taxi to the runway.The stewardess went through the usual procedures for takeoff and emergencies. Once we took off, we were advised there was turbulence for most of the way, but to be honest you barely felt it. We were offered a Sandwich of choice and a drink and cookie/cake if required. The flight went by very quickly and felt like less than an hour. The landing was very smooth as I have always experienced with hop. I'm looking forward to returning to Paris next April, our new favourite City. and I've just booked our tickets with Air France (Hop!) again.
reviews.author: MaxHunter

reviews.title: Hop Airline from Paris to Tarbes (Lourdes)
reviews.text: Our trip to Lourdes happened to coincide with the train strike in France. Fortunately our TGV tickets were refundable, so I was able to switch from train to plane without the train penalty. There was not much time to shop for a flight, but I thought I should stay from Air France, which was also on strike. I picked HOP! via CheapoAir, and I had no idea HOP! is also related to AF. While making the reservation for the 5 of us, CheapOAir required full identity and birthdate of all passengers. Since this info was in my home computer, I had to stop the reservation midway, and continue at home. In the 20 minutes that it took me to go back to the reservation, the ticket price had gone up by $50.00 each! This was 4 days before our trip to Lourdes, no time for comparison shopping.. So in a panic I bought the tickets right away and also purchased 5 cancellation insurance just in case. We had carry-ons + one passenger on a wheelchair. Check-in was uneventful. The waiting area was crowded, and it had work tables with electric plugs. The attendants took my sister and her husband in his wheelchair ahead of us. We could not pre-select our seats, but we had seats close to each other. The seats are more spacious than Delta Airlines economy. The attendants served drinks and cookies for the 1 1/2 hour flight. We did not see any waiting taxis at Tarbes airport, but there was a big sign in the waiting area that had the phone number to call for taxi service. The person who answered the phone spoke English, fully understood that there were 5 of us. The big van arrived in about 10 minutes, but before reaching us, he picked up a couple of passengers who were also going to Lourdes. It took about 45 minutes to reach Lourdes, and we gave the driver EUR50 for the 7 of us. To avoid problems with carrying Lourdes water into the passenger section of the plane, we put all of our water in one small carry-on and checked it in. By the way, at our arrival, Orly Airport did not have taxi dispatchers and were duped into paying EUR80 for the van trip from Orly to our apartment in 1st arrondisment in Paris. All in all, travel time by plane saved us a couple of hours of travel time and gave us more time at Lourdes, for about $100.00 more per person.
reviews.author: Maria H

reviews.title: Full marks HOP! Full marks Bombardier!
reviews.text: Air France operate an internal carrier named HOP! I’d never heard of them. The airport in both cities is close to town so getting to and from was never an issue. Just a flight with a carrier I didn't know. HOP! operated a Bombardier CRJ1000 on the route. It’s a Canadian built 100-odd seater. Very comfortable, good seat pitch, two-by-two seating, large windows but still, a bit like being at the back of cigar tube. Take-off seemed late, as if we needed extra speed. Although the flight encountered rough weather, we were quite comfortable in the air. Touch-down was hard, but there was wind about. 100 marks out of 100 for the pilots. HOP! service from airport to airport was first class. Two attendants managed all the passengers, simple coffee, juice and biscuits. Very polished, very professional. Full marks HOP! Full marks Bombardier!
reviews.author: Ian R

reviews.title: Free Seeting - a bit chaotic
reviews.text: Neither positive or negative exitement. The personnel was friendly, the boarding went a bit chaotiv, some people got new tickets at the gate and then got even different seats in the plan. After a few minutes the crew gave up of the chaos and everyone else got free seating. Never had that before. Somehow funny but also concenring as it highlighted organizational weakpoints. I am tall and usually my first look goes to the space for the knees. In this plane it was boarderline for me but it was only a 50min flight.
reviews.author: Klaus W
